title: custom:entity-card-pro
description: One entity as a tile or a poster. The entity keys sit directly on the card; rules drive icon, colour, label and card tint. Strings containing {{ }} are Jinja templates rendered by Home Assistant (name, secondary, icon, color, value).

layout.description: tile: Home Assistant's tile; poster: the icon and pills on top, the name and the big value at the bottom

badges.description: poster: badges in its corner, below the rule's label (an outline pill unless a style is set)
